lots.guide_summary: Guide $15 to $45 AUD hammer for the whole lot, all of it SOLD evidence from four Gowans (Hobart) lots of two tubs of assorted books in the last 13 months (close, not identical, contents undescribed). Art book tubs at Gowans run $10 to $115 as a category guide. The only single-title evidence is two asking prices of about AUD 22 to 25 for in-print or common glass reference books. No unsold evidence. Rates assumed: 1 USD = 1.50 AUD, 1 GBP = 2.00 AUD.
lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD = $15 (Gowans 389772, 2 tubs asst books, Feb 2026). 15 / 1.22 = 12.30, round down to $10. Flip: likely resale about $30 hammer (median of $15, $20, $30, $45 two-tub lots), less about 15% selling fees ($4.50) and $0 outbound postage (sold locally as a pickup lot) = $25.50; 25.50 / 2.44 = 10.45, round down to $10. Both maxima are tiny, so the lot is DROP unless the user wants specific titles for themselves.
lots.confidence_reason: Spines and covers read clearly in the photos, and there are four opened SOLD bulk-lot results at Gowans, but bulk book lots vary with contents so they are close rather than same-item; single-title evidence is asking only.
lots.dropped_entries: Alibris Made in Czechoslovakia US$3 to 13.82: HTTP 403, snippet only, dropped. eBay.de signed Hallmarks of Antique Glass GBP 20: eBay closed to us, snippet only, and a signed copy (ours not seen signed), dropped. Biblio UK Hans Hofmann GBP 76.90 to 80.95: HTTP 403, snippet only, and a different book (2002 Rizzoli/Yohe, not the Abrams Hunter monograph), dropped. AbeBooks Miro as Sculptor US$160: page opened, a different book (Dupin, Poligrafa 1976) from our Perucho Miro, dropped. Brunk Auctions 70 glass and perfume reference books: page opened; the researcher filed it as an estimate (ASKING) but it actually SOLD for US$200 excluding premium against a US$400 to 600 estimate on 15 July 2022, so it is mislabelled, more than 24 months old and a much stronger specialist lot, dropped.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1: two tubs, mostly paperbacks and slim hardbacks on Australian local history (Magpie Fly Over, A History of Bonnie Doon Golf Club). Photo 2: George Savage Glass (Universal Books), John Bedford Bristol, Wilkinson Hallmarks of Antique Glass, How to Restore and Repair Practically Everything, Forsythe Made in Czechoslovakia, Steam Trains (Nelson). Photo 3: The Painted Stream, Toma Tadashi, Ciruelo Cabral, 50 Years Sweden, Colours of Australia, Superpen, This Other Eden. Photo 4: Hans Hofmann (jacket with printed signature) and Miro by Juan Perucho in jackets with some edge wear. Photo 5: Hallmarks of Antique Glass jacket worn at edges. Photo 6: The Second Fleet Convicts, The Third Fleet Convicts, Legend Walk. No signed or first edition rarities seen.
